summary: Joel is the managing director and Co-CIO of Gotham Capital, which has produced spectacular returns for over 3 decades. On top of that, he is a professor at Columbia University, where he teaches value investing to MBA students.

 Search Home New Top Charts Sign In March 7, 2021 Common Sense Investing w/ Joel Greenblatt The Investor's Podcast (We Study Billionaires) - The Investor’s Podcast Network 1h 4m Trey Lockerbie is joined by legendary investor, Joel Greenblatt. Joel is the managing director and Co-CIO of Gotham Capital, which has produced spectacular returns for over 3 decades.

  He is also the author of investing classics like The Little Book that Beats the Market, and You Can Be a Stock Market Genius. On top of that, he is a professor at Columbia University, where he teaches value investing to MBA students.

 IN THIS EPISODE, YOU'LL LEARN: 

 
 Joel Greenblatt’s investing philosophy 
 The case for diversification as well as 
 The case for a concentrated portfolio 
 How Joel thinks through position sizing 
 And much, much more!
